descripcion: Video de marca tipo Absen «Beyond the Display» (1 a 3 min): tus videos y fotos reales montados con narración, música, sobreimpresos y subtítulos, más tomas de cine con Wan 3.0 solo donde no hace falta mostrar el producto real (gancho y mundos de uso).
vozSugerida: Voz masculina o femenina corporativa, cálida y segura (no locutor de radio).

musicaIA.prompt: Epic modern corporate cinematic underscore for a technology brand film: warm synth pads, pulsing bass, rising strings and big tom hits building to a confident finale, no vocals, leaves room for a narrator.
musicaIA.promptRafaga: High-energy cinematic electronic brand-film track at a steady 124 BPM, like a tech launch trailer. {intro} After the drop: punchy four-on-the-floor kick, tight claps, pulsing sidechained synth bass, bright arpeggios, big tom hits and whoosh transitions every 8 bars, energy building section by section. Leaves space in the mids for a short narrator line now and then. Ends with a final big hit and a clean 2-second ring-out. Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics.
